# Betclic & GrowthBook Technical Demo
Date: 2026-11-03 | Duration: 65.62999725341797m

## Summary
Betclic’s GrowthBook evaluation is nearing final review, with the RFP response expected within the week or at the beginning of next month and a solution decision targeted by year-end. The team identified manual experiment tracking, fragmented A/B testing tools, limited conflict visibility, and dependence on engineering and data teams as key challenges. GrowthBook proposed a unified platform for mobile, web, and server-side experimentation, with Snowflake-native analysis, reusable metrics, templates, self-service workflows, feature flags, controlled rollouts, and flexible targeting. Betclic still needs deeper validation of identity mapping, exposure attribution, gaming-revenue events, stopping rules, statistical methodology, and monitoring. GrowthBook can operate alongside existing feature-management infrastructure and use read-only Snowflake access. Immediate next steps include completing the RFP, providing pricing information, exchanging sizing questions, and arranging a data-science follow-up involving GrowthBook’s lead and Betclic’s lead analyst.

## Keywords
Experimentation platform, Snowflake analytics, Feature flags, A/B testing, Statistical attribution, Experiment governance

# BetClic & GrowthBook DS Session
Date: 2026-11-18 | Duration: 40m

## Summary
GrowthBook’s open-source version was tested locally by Klaus Fleerkötter with successful initial results, and its current architecture is viewed as a possible path for advancing experimentation. The preferred model uses GrowthBook as an analysis layer on Snowflake while retaining BetClic’s existing attribution layer, SDKs, impression data, and analyst workflows. A standalone exposure-assignment query would define experiment populations, variants, and exposure timestamps, while template variables could support experiment-specific event filtering. Time-windowed metrics, concurrent experimentation, sequential testing, and configurable minimum durations were discussed as safeguards for reliable analysis. BetClic’s sports betting, casino, poker, and horse products are mostly isolated, although some cross-universe activity exists; interaction effects are not expected to commonly prevent concurrent testing. Vendor evaluation will continue for approximately two weeks. January timing remains unconfirmed because IT and other teams have competing priorities. Edouard will provide further RFP details and a clearer implementation plan, while James Shannon will arrange a commercial discussion covering pricing and planning.

## Keywords
Experimentation analysis, Snowflake, Exposure attribution, Sequential testing, Parallel experiments, Cluster randomisation

# BetClic & GrowthBook Commercial Discussion
Date: 2026-11-24 | Duration: 41.939998626708984m

## Summary
GrowthBook presented an enterprise proposal covering a $100,000 base license, $1,000 per seat annually, and an example $300,000 total for 200 seats, with possible volume discounts. The value model included revenue lift, avoided losses, and analyst-time savings, with an illustrative $9.85 million combined annual benefit and $5.4 million net revenue impact. The customer targets 50–100 tests per quarter and views GrowthBook as a strong functional fit, although competitors are priced lower. Self-hosting in AWS is the preferred deployment because cloud hosting may require review of personally identifiable login data and EU data-transfer issues; functionality and statistical capability are stated to be equivalent. MongoDB Atlas, AWS ECS, and Snowflake are expected to support the environment. Hosting was estimated at $2,000–$4,000 annually, while Snowflake usage may approach $5,000 monthly, with optimization potentially reducing comparable costs by 80%. RFP evaluation continues this week, with clearer internal direction expected within approximately two weeks. A two-to-four-week self-hosted POC may follow legal, procurement, and vendor-selection approval.

## Keywords
GrowthBook enterprise licensing, Self-hosted deployment, Experimentation platform, Snowflake optimisation, Proof of concept, A/B testing analytics
